note: Questions written for this build (CC0). expected lists answer strings, any one of which must appear in the answer as a whole word or number; sources lists the sources that contain the answer. An empty expected list means the sources do not answer the question. The 10 development questions were used to check the prompt, the JSON schema and k. The 8 held-out questions were written on 2026-10-20 after those were fixed and run once.
